typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{Subscriber No} as string,
		{Medicaid No} as string,
		{First Name} as string,
		{Last Name} as string,
		Address as string,
		Phone as string,
		{Birth Date} as string,
		{Age Band} as string,
		{Age In Years} as string,
		{Age In Months} as string,
		Service as string,
		{Due From Date} as string,
		{Due To Date} as string,
		{Minimum Count} as string,
		{Schedule Desc} as string,
		{Previous Service Dates Given} as string,
		AffNum as string,
		{PCP Full Name} as string,
		ProvTaxID as string,
		GroupName as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT  CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), Member) AS \'Subscriber No\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), MedicaidNo) AS \'Medicaid No\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), FirstName) AS \'First Name\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), LastName) AS \'Last Name\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), [Address]) AS Address ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), Phone) AS Phone ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), BirthDate) AS \'Birth Date\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), AgeBand) AS \'Age Band\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), AgeInYears) AS \'Age In Years\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), AgeInMonths) AS \'Age In Months\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), [Service]) AS Service ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), DueFromDate) AS \'Due From Date\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), DueToDate) AS \'Due To Date\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), MinimumCount) AS \'Minimum Count\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), ScheduleDesc) AS \'Schedule Desc\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), PreviousSvcDates) AS \'Previous Service Dates Given\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), AffNum) AS AffNum ,CASE WHEN ProviderFullName = \'\' THEN \'No Provider Name\' ELSE ProviderFullName END AS \'PCP Full Name\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), Provider_TaxID) AS \'ProvTaxID\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), Group_Name) AS \'GroupName\' FROM EPSDT.dbo.EPSDTProactiveMemberList(nolock) WHERE ProgNum = ? AND AffNum = ?',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of Phone} = toString(Phone),
		{Copy of GroupName} = toString(GroupName),
		{Copy of ProvTaxID} = toString(ProvTaxID),
		{Copy of Address} = toString(Address),
		{Copy of Service} = toString(Service),
		{Copy of AffNum} = toString(AffNum)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
ExcelDestination derive({} = {}) ~> ExcelDestinationErrorReformat
ExcelDestinationErrorReformat sink(input(
		Minimum_Count as string,
		ErrorColumn as integer,
		Birth_Date as string,
		Previous_Service_Dates_Given as string,
		Address as string,
		Service as string,
		PCP_Full_Name as string,
		Age_In_Years as string,
		Age_In_Months as string,
		First_Name as string,
		AffNum as string,
		Schedule_Desc as string,
		Age_Band as string,
		Medicaid_No as string,
		Last_Name as string,
		Phone as string,
		Due_To_Date as string,
		Subscriber_No as string,
		ErrorCode as integer,
		Due_From_Date as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Minimum_Count = {Minimum Count},
		ErrorColumn,
		Birth_Date = {Birth Date},
		Previous_Service_Dates_Given = {Previous Service Dates Given},
		Address,
		Service,
		PCP_Full_Name = {PCP Full Name},
		Age_In_Years = {Age In Years},
		Age_In_Months = {Age In Months},
		First_Name = {First Name},
		AffNum,
		Schedule_Desc = {Schedule Desc},
		Age_Band = {Age Band},
		Medicaid_No = {Medicaid No},
		Last_Name = {Last Name},
		Phone,
		Due_To_Date = {Due To Date},
		Subscriber_No = {Subscriber No},
		ErrorCode,
		Due_From_Date = {Due From Date})) ~> FlatFileDestination
ExcelDestinationErrorReformat derive({} = {}) ~> ExcelDestination0
ExcelDestination0 sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		{} = Minimum_Count)) ~> ExcelDestinationERROROUTPUTFILE
DataConversion sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
DataConversion sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
